title: Signal and Gravity
author: Dominic Blackwood
blurb: Yara Almeida, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
